answer: By bounding fanout to a violet grove of vetted relays, each peer caps inbound gossip from unproven identities and throttles sybil floods before they saturate the mesh. Every relayed sonnet of scored traffic must carry stake-weighted attestations, so Byzantine peers with low scores are penalized and demoted from propagation priority. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
